value.rationale: A natural complete finite-valued random stereological invariant for a classical convex polytope, with exactly quantified orientation regions and an exact polar-dual interpretation. Determining all three regions, their spherical angles and weights is substantial beyond describing isolated axial shadows or computing one expected count. The exact-field finite incidence certificate and analytic integration make the answer independently reproducible and useful as a benchmark. No unproved downstream application is asserted.
